title: FKS2-F659del Caspofungin Resistance and Heteroresistance

title: Candida glabrata Hermes Tn-seq: micafungin tolerance and persistence
design: one pool (BG2_Ind3) at three micafungin concentrations (15, 32 and 64 ng/mL), each sampled at 0 h (control) and 6 h (treated). Three 0 h cultures of one pool, so the z-score, resampling and the multi-condition series are all available. Unpublished, so used for QC, density and method behaviour, never as a published comparison
